# Deviload 2.15.0

**Lyrics that meet the voice, a song recognised from anything that plays, and your music coming over by itself.** Devil Music now knows which recording is playing and times the words to it, tells you the song from your computer's sound or a file, keeps your YouTube Music likes in step, and opens the moods at once.

- Lyrics are in time on every version of a song. YouTube often plays a music video with a longer intro or a re-upload that starts late; Devil Music listens to a few seconds of the recording once, finds where it is in the studio recording and shifts the words by the difference. Another version of the song gets its own measurement, and the music video's picture follows the song the same way. Only a fingerprint of the sound is sent, never the sound.
- Lyrics no longer flicker: sung words keep their light, the lines around the current one change only in brightness, and the next line glides into place just as it is sung.
- Identify song sits beside the search and listens to the room, to this computer's sound (a song in a browser, a video or a game) or to an audio or video file. The songs found are kept, to search again or like in one click.
- Turn on Bring new likes from YouTube Music in music settings and your new likes come over to Liked songs once a day, or at once with the button. The account is only read. A song removed here is not brought back.
- Bringing your music is faster and clearer: songs already in your library are matched without a search, up to 20,000 matches are remembered between imports, the counts agree everywhere, and the review has one scroll with Add always in reach.

### Devil Music

The home shows new albums and singles from the artists you follow. Moods open at once, read ahead while the home is open, and New this week, Top hits, Workout and Road trip join them. A playlist's menu downloads all its songs for listening offline.

Music settings are grouped into Accounts, Playback, Suggestions, Privacy, Integrations and App. With the local control API on, Copy OBS link gives a page for an OBS browser source with the song playing on a transparent background. The music profile section exports your liked songs and playlists as CSV, M3U or JSON.

In Cinema, label videos that refuse the embedded player now play with their sound: the picture plays here and the song's sound from Devil Music follows it.

The library rail stays tidy with many playlists, Add to playlist shows the song and playlist covers with a search for long lists, and the artist of the top search result opens their page.

### Fixes

The song menu (…) opens beside its button instead of off the screen. Letters below the line are no longer cut in the player's menu. Resuming an unfinished import shows where the songs came from and keeps them if the app closes. The play position sliders stop costing frames while nothing plays.

On Windows, run the setup EXE over your installed copy to keep your library and settings.
